package main

import "fmt"

type Small float32
type Count uint64
type Delta int64

func belowZero() float32 { return -2.5 }
func namedFloat() Small { return Small(7.75) }
func namedUint() Count  { return Count(1<<63 + 5) }
func namedInt() Delta   { return -1 }

func main() {
	var x float32 = belowZero()
	_ = uint64(x)

	y := namedFloat()
	z := namedUint()
	d := namedInt()
	fmt.Println("done", uint64(y), uint64(z), uint64(d) == ^uint64(0))
}
